name: IC Driver Display — 3.3V, I2C, SPI — EA
description: Display driver IC cluster operating at 3.3V with I2C and SPI interfaces, featuring through-hole mounting in the EA package family.
selection_hints: Select for 3.3V display driver applications requiring I2C or SPI communication.
Use when through-hole mounting with EA footprints like EA_DOGS104X-A or EA_DOGXL160-7 is required.
Prefer higher quality tier A parts over tier C entries.

Operating voltages other than 3.3V are required.
A package family other than EA is specified.
